These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Synapse platform ("Service"), operated by Trendex Hub ("we", "us", "our"). By accessing or using Synapse, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, you may not use the Service.

2. Description of Service

Synapse is an autonomous business management platform that integrates with Google Business Profile and Google Ads APIs to help businesses:

  • Manage and update their Google Business Profile listing
  • Autonomously publish daily content posts to their Google Business Profile
  • Draft and submit replies to customer reviews using AI assistance
  • Monitor business performance metrics and analytics
  • Manage Google Ads campaigns (upcoming feature)

The Service is currently operated as an autonomous agent platform. Certain features perform actions on your Google Business Profile automatically, subject to the policy safeguards described in Section 5.

3. Account Access and Google API Authorisation

To use Synapse, you must authorise the platform to access your Google Account via OAuth 2.0. By granting this authorisation, you acknowledge that:

  • Synapse will access your Google Business Profile data and take automated actions on your behalf
  • You are the authorised account holder or have explicit permission from the account holder
  • You can revoke this access at any time via your Google Account settings
  • Synapse's use of Google API data is governed by the Google API Services User Data Policy

4. User Responsibilities

You are solely responsible for:

  • Maintaining the security of your API credentials and access keys used to authenticate with Synapse
  • Ensuring that the content published to your Google Business Profile via Synapse complies with Google's Business Profile policies
  • Reviewing autonomous actions taken by Synapse via the audit log and flagging any inaccuracies
  • Ensuring that any Google Ads campaigns managed through the platform comply with Google Ads policies
  • Providing accurate and lawful business information on your Google Business Profile
  • Notifying us promptly of any unauthorised access to your Synapse account

5. Autonomous Agent Safeguards

Synapse's autonomous features are designed with built-in policy safeguards. The agent will:

  • Only auto-reply to 4-star and 5-star reviews; all others are flagged for human review
  • Block content containing prohibited terms (medical claims, guarantees, or inappropriate language)
  • Publish a maximum of one post per day to avoid spam
  • Never include external URLs, contact information, or off-brand content in auto-generated posts

While these safeguards are designed to protect you, you remain responsible for reviewing and, if necessary, correcting any content published by the autonomous agent.

6. Google Ads — Financial Responsibility

Trendex Hub and the Synapse platform are not responsible for any ad spend, budget overruns, or billing charges on your Google Ads account. You must manage your campaign budgets and payment settings directly within your Google Ads account. Synapse only provides management and optimisation assistance — it does not control or hold funds on your behalf.
